e.title: insurance-reconcile
e.summary: 层次预测调和（burning-cost）：PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation，费率层级一致性
e.summary_en: Hierarchical forecast reconciliation (burning-cost): PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation, rate hierarchy consistency
e.summary_hk: 層次預測調和（burning-cost）：PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation，費率層級一致性
e.body:
insurance-reconcile（burning-cost）做层次预测调和：PremiumWeightedMinTrace、LossRatioReconciliation——保单/单元/组合/产品层级预测的一致性调整（低层预测之和 = 高层预测）。对 RIAA：费率结构的层级一致性是实务要求——组合预测应等于单元预测之和（否则管理层无法解读）；层次调和（reconciliation）是预测领域的标准方法（Hyndman 学派）；与 [[insurance-calibration]]（校准）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（监测）配套；适合定价/准备金预测的汇总一致性问题。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-scmoe]]、[[insurance-sensitivity]]、[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
insurance-reconcile (burning-cost) does hierarchical forecast reconciliation: PremiumWeightedMinTrace, LossRatioReconciliation — adjusting forecasts across policy/cell/portfolio/product hierarchies so lower-level forecasts sum to higher levels. For RIAA: hierarchy consistency of rate structures is a practical requirement — portfolio forecasts should equal the sum of cell forecasts (or management cannot interpret them); reconciliation is the standard forecast method (Hyndman school); pairs with [[insurance-calibration]] (calibration) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (monitoring); suits aggregation-consistency problems in pricing/reserving forecasts.

## Similar tools
[[insurance-scmoe]]、[[insurance-sensitivity]]、[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
insurance-reconcile（burning-cost）做層次預測調和：PremiumWeightedMinTrace、LossRatioReconciliation——保單/單元/組合/產品層級預測的一致性調整（低層預測之和 = 高層預測）。對 RIAA：費率結構的層級一致性是實務要求——組合預測應等於單元預測之和（否則管理層無法解讀）；層次調和（reconciliation）是預測領域的標準方法（Hyndman 學派）；與 [[insurance-calibration]]（校準）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（監測）配套；適合定價/準備金預測的匯總一致性問題。
